mapper.sql: id, user_id, scene_id, scene_name, trigger_type, trigger_device_id, trigger_device_key, trigger_device_name, trigger_identifier, trigger_value, trigger_event_type, trigger_source, total_steps, finished_steps, status, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE scene_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{startedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE scene_execution SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE scene_execution SET finished_steps = finished_steps + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE scene_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', error_message = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
